summary: Beamr Imaging Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on April 20, 2026, reporting the results of its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders held on the same day. All three proposals—which were described in the earlier proxy statement filed on March 13, 2026—were approved. No specific proposal details, vote tallies, or deal terms are disclosed in this filing. The filing is a routine current report of meeting results and does not indicate any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, management change, or restructuring. Accordingly, this is categorized as 'None'.
